Name: Rainbow Rain (Unofficial Update)
Author: moonprismm
Description:
This is an unofficial update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9825?tab=description]Rainbow Rain[/url]﻿ by dunni.

All credit goes to dunni for creating this mod, all I did was change the image file so it's compatible with 1.6.

I was given permission to post this. Thank you for the mod, dunni!

Downloads.Description: Unofficial update to Rainbow Rain making it 1.6 compatible. Please let me know if there are issues.

Manifest.Description: It adds some colour to your rainy days in Stardew Valley, making for some very pretty photo - ops.
